signature_moves: Hybrid graphic numerals: Arabic 12 & 2-9 mixed with stroke-glyphs I (1), II (11), IC (10) - shape rhyme over arithmetic; a Bauhaus typographic conceit that is the entire identity in one decision
Day/night rendered as literal watch-dial legibility (cream-on-mint vs cyan Super-LumiNova on black), not a UI appearance inversion
Tangentially-rotated outer minute track (05-60) - Braun/Rams wall-clock citation held as recessive micro-typography
Lume-channel baton hands with counter-weighted thin seconds needle
defects: None-as-UI - a screensaver canvas is not answerable to the interaction rubric; faulting it for lacking controls would be a category error. Minute-track low contrast is intentional decorative de-emphasis, not Contrast Dilution.

aesthetic.direction: Swiss/International-modernist crossed with Industrial/instrument-dial - a Braun/Dieter-Rams wall-clock homage; restrained neutral ground + geometric numerals + exposed dial metadata (minute track)
peers: Braun BN/ABW wall clocks (Dieter Rams / Dietrich Lubs)
Mac screensaver peers: Fliqlo, Padbury Clock, Word Clock

psychology: Jakob's Law - obeys the universal analog-clock mental model (12 top, clockwise), so the numeral substitution (10=IC) never blocks reading; position carries the hour, not the glyph. Mild recognition tax from the conceit is bought back by convention.
Von Restorff / hierarchy-by-de-emphasis - recessive gray minute track lets the dark/luminous hour numerals + hands own attention; the grayscale hierarchy survives colour removal.
Aesthetic-usability effect - lume realism and horological hand detailing raise perceived quality/premium of an inherently trivial utility.
